content.short: Paragons DAO is a gaming community where members can borrow or lend assets and access data for Web3 games.
content.description: Paragons DAO is a gaming community where members can borrow or lend playable assets and access gaming and economic data for premier Web3 games, including Parallel. PDT holders take part in on-chain governance to grow, educate, and sponsor a fun, effective gaming ecosystem while lowering the barriers to entry for new Web3 gamers. It emphasizes collaborative asset sharing, data-driven insights, and inclusive participation to support a thriving, community-driven gaming culture. No capital is required.
